title: ENC encoder daughterboard (PEC11R-4220F-S0024): one design for ENC301 and ENC302, plus one spare
note: W2 PCB-SB1 board, from the W2 PCB-PIPE pilot (same outline, holes, encoder anchor and scripted GND link). The ENC end of S37/S38 is the 4-pad land J1: the 26 AWG harness wires are soldered into it and nothing is fitted (decision 'Роз'єм плати ENC (W2 PCB-SB1)' in build/15). J1 stays a pilot_placeholder because no ENC-domain graph ref exists for the land yet (design/E3.json is outside PCB-SB1). CI/model output only; nothing here is a fabrication release and the bench gates stay OPEN.

layers.source: PCB-SB1 plan: ENC is a 2-layer 1.6 mm 1 oz board (final-plan.json PCB-SB1 brief); the 4-layer default of build/15 'Шари' is for the main boards; decision 'Шари малих плат ENC і HATCH (W2 PCB-SB1)' in build/15

plan.B.Cu: scripted GND link, signals, GND pour

rules_note: The rules live in the committed ENC.kicad_pro (project choice above the fab floor: track 0.25 / clearance 0.2, minimum 0.15 / 0.15, via 0.6 / 0.3, copper-edge 0.3, hole-hole 0.5, hole clearance 0.25, text 1.0 / 0.15). pcb/rules/jlc-2l.kicad_dru (W2 PCB-RULES) is not attached: pcb/board_gen.py still refuses a non-null rules_file (copying the .kicad_dru into the board directory and hashing it are not implemented, validate_spec), so rules_file stays null (OPEN for the board_gen lineage, W2 PCB-SB1).

fab_floor.min_hole_to_hole_note: 0.45 = pad hole-to-hole of different nets; via hole-to-hole is 0.2

parts.pins_source: build/16-dzhgut-rozyemy.csv:49 and :50 (X37S0-ENCM / X38S0-ENCV: synthesized ENC ends of S37/S38, pins GND, A, B, PRESS, not graph refs) in the contact order of the CTRL ends J316/J317 (:37, :38; design/E3.json J316/J317 pins 1-4 GND, ENCx_A_RAW, ENCx_B_RAW, ENCx_PRESS_EXT)
parts.replaced_by: nothing is fitted: the four 26 AWG S37/S38 wires are soldered into this land (W2 PCB-SB1); a graph ref for the land (ENC domain, mount pcb_pad) is pending in design/E3.json (GR lineage)
parts.pending_note: The boundary-audit text is kept verbatim (pcb/tests/test_board_gen.py test_enc_keeps_the_acceptance_string pins it). GR-3 left the ENC ends synthesized (tools/assembly_data.py PENDING_BOARD_ENDS); the ref now waits for the GR lineage (design/E3.json), which must map J1 here in the same change because an ENC-domain ref fails the domain audit of this spec until it is mapped.
parts.why_placeholder: No JST PH housing fits beside the PEC11R on the 24 x 24 outline: the S4B-PH-K side-entry body is 7.6 mm deep and the B4B-PH-K vertical courtyard 5.5 mm wide, while the strip between the left edge and the PEC11R courtyard is 4.5 mm (encoder at 90 deg) and a vertical PH is 8 mm tall against the 6.5 mm envelope (tools/assembly_data.py:120-121). Decision (W2 PCB-SB1, build/15): the pilot's 2.0 mm 4-pad land stays as the solder-wire land of the S37/S38 pigtail, in the contract edge zone left [6, 18] (pads at y 9-15); the PH 4 housing is only at the CTRL end (J316/J317 S4B-PH-K). Land: KiCad 10.0.7 PinHeader_1x04_P2.00mm_Vertical, drill 0.8, pad 1.35 (gitlab raw 10.0.7, read 2026-11-07, sha256 as above); wire: Alpha Wire 5853, 26 AWG 7/34, OD 0.99 mm (design/parts/snapshots/2026-11-07-w2-src1-manual.json web:alphawire-5853), stripped end through the 0.8 mm hole.
